name: GPU Marching Cubes (Face-based)
definition: A GPU-based surface extraction method that generates a triangle mesh from a voxel grid by processing each voxel independently on the GPU. It outputs vertices and indices into global buffers using atomic counters for parallel write safety.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes extracts triangle meshes from voxel grids by generating axis-aligned faces on the GPU, differing from standard Marching Cubes by avoiding polygon interpolation.
